title: Trump administration attributes New Jersey drones to the FAA

tellings.quote: I think the first uh, you know, official act that the Trump administration took in dismissing what was going on up in uh, New Jersey, for example, that this was an FAA regulated uh, set of set of events.

plain: When mysterious drones were reported over New Jersey around 2024 and 2025, the first official act of the Trump administration was to dismiss them by saying the flights were regulated by the FAA, the US Federal Aviation Administration, which oversees air traffic. A Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell says this in conversation with Michels, as his own reading of the government's response. He raises it as an example of officials brushing the sightings aside.
